mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dd_evidence_ref(evidence_id, requirement_id, case_subject_id, file_id, content_hash, status, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.evidenceId}, #{row.requirementId}, #{row.caseSubjectId}, #{row.fileId}, #{row.contentHash}, #{row.status}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT e.evidence_id AS evidenceId, e.requirement_id AS requirementId, e.case_subject_id AS caseSubjectId, e.file_id AS fileId, e.content_hash AS contentHash, e.status, e.version, e.create_time AS createTime, e.update_time AS updateTime FROM t_dd_evidence_ref e JOIN t_dd_requirement r ON r.requirement_id = e.requirement_id WHERE r.case_id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_dd_evidence_ref SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE evidence_id = #{row.evidenceId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = 'RECEIVED'
